label: For "Online Harm Report Triage": Classify reports of online abuse and harassment by type and urgency so people at risk reach a human fast and referral partners get the right cases, with no automatic decisions on content or users. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Automatic sanctions.
